subject: Re: Request: vuln ops proofpoints, scan rhythm and exception log
messages:
From: Jared Bloom <jared.bloom@acmegroupllc.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: security@acmegroupllc.com
Date: 2028-11-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: vuln ops proofpoints and exception log for SIG review

Hi Markus,

Thanks for agreeing to help with Acme's SIG intake. Our SIG reviewer asked for concrete evidence around Redwood's vulnerability management cadence and any outstanding exception items for the last 12 months. Specifically we need: 

- A short statement of scan cadence (tools, frequency, scope) and how results map to SLA buckets (P1/P2/P3).
- Samples of artifacts that demonstrate closure within your stated SLAs for three recent CVEs (one P1, one P2, one P3). Artifacts can be: scan export, patch PR link, CVE remediation manifest, and endpoint verification logs.
- A log of exceptions (components excluded from regular scans or extended mitigation windows) dated and reasoned, with owner.
- A signed attestation that critical (P1) CVEs are addressed per your 72/45/14 model (we flagged differing language in earlier responses).

Deadline: our SIG window closes 2028-11-15. Can you deliver the packet or a confirmed plan by 2028-11-10?

I've attached a one-page checklist and sample intake form to guide delivery. If you'd prefer a short call to scope, we can do 30 min tomorrow afternoon.

Thanks,
Jared Bloom
Head of Vendor Security, Acme Group
[jared.bloom@acmegroupllc.com]

Attachments: acme-vuln-request-checklist.pdf
From: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Bloom <jared.bloom@acmegroupllc.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-11-08T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: vuln ops proofpoints and exception log for SIG review

Jared — thanks for the clear ask and the checklist. We're on it. High-level response below; full packet (artifacts + attestation) targeted for 2028-11-10 as requested.

Quick answers up front:
- Scan cadence: weekly authenticated network and container scans (Tenable + Clair), daily lightweight host endpoint scans for known high-risk vectors, and monthly full-image binary checks. Weekly scans are scheduled for Saturday 02:00 UTC; monthly full scans run on first Sunday of month.
- SLA mapping: P1 = 72 hours to mitigation plan + 14 days to fix (hotpatch/rollback plan if needed); P2 = 14 days; P3 = 45 days. We will include a signed attestation with the exact language.
- Exceptions: we track exceptions in a dedicated exceptions ledger (internal) with owner and compensating controls. We'll include a redacted extract for SIG (owner names and PR ids preserved).

Deliverables we'll provide by 2028-11-10: 
1) scan-rhythm-summary-2028Q3.csv (export showing scan timestamps for the last 90 days)
2) remediation-evidence-template.xlsx filled for three CVEs (P1/P2/P3) including PR ids and patch manifests
3) exception-log-redacted.csv (component, reason, owner, start/end date, compensating control)
4) signed attestation PDF for P1/P2/P3 SLA commitments (DocuSign link)

Can we confirm whether you want raw Tenable exports or standardized CSV snapshots? We can provide both but raw exports are larger and may require a secure transfer.

I'll schedule the 30-min scoping slot for 2028-11-08 16:00 UTC unless you ask otherwise.

Best,
Markus Klein
Director, Security Programs
Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-scan-rhythm-summary-2028Q3.csv
From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-11-08T13:30:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: vuln ops proofpoints and exception log for SIG review

Markus / Ben — forwarding Jared's request and Markus' summary. Action items and internal notes below.

--- Forwarded message ---
On 2028-11-08 11:03, markus_klein@redwood.ai wrote:
> Jared — thanks for the clear ask and the checklist. We're on it...

Internal notes (deliverable details):
- Evidence types we will include per CVE sample: Tenable JSON export (sanitized), PR link (Github), build artifact checksum, patch manifest PDF, and endpoint verification (osquery query + timestamped result).
- For P1 sample (CVE-2028-998): we have active rollback-proof in place and a closed PR (GH#12452). We'll include the PR, the patch manifest (cve-2028-998-fix-manifest.pdf) and the osquery verification output used in production.
- For P2 sample: include PR and config change checklist; target closure evidence within 14d SLA.
- Exceptions: produce redacted ledger; ensure we include 'reason' column and compensating control references (WAF rule IDs).
- Attestation: compliance will sign the doc (Kim). Kim, please confirm final language for the 72/14/45 model and whether we want to include a carve-out for third-party managed components.

Deadline reminder: packet to external by 2028-11-10 EOD PDT. If we cannot include raw Tenable exports by that date, include CSV summaries and a secure-transfer ETA.

Attachments to prepare internally: remediation-evidence-template.xlsx (tabbed: P1, P2, P3), exception-log-redacted.csv

Thanks — Monica
Sr. Manager, Vulnerability Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: remediation-evidence-template.xlsx

Subject: Re: Request: vuln ops proofpoints and exception log for SIG review — packet attached and attestation link

Jared — sending the consolidated packet for the SIG window. Apologies for the slightly long email; I've summarized the important bits at the top.

Summary (top lines):
- Scan cadence: weekly authenticated network & container scans (Tenable + Clair), daily lightweight host telemetry scans, monthly full-image checks. CSV export included (redwood-scan-rhythm-summary-2028Q3.csv).
- SLA attestation: P1: plan within 72 hours, fix/mitigation within 14 days (exceptions captured); P2: 14 days; P3: 45 days. Signed attestation (DocuSign) at: https://docusign.redwood.ai/attest/HS-7421 (expires 2028-12-01).
- Artifacts included: three CVE packets (P1: CVE-2028-998, GH#12452; P2: CVE-2028-743, GH#12301; P3: CVE-2028-602, GH#12111). Each packet contains: sanitized Tenable export (CSV), PR link, patch manifest, and endpoint verification snippets.
- Exception log: exception-log-redacted.csv (component, owner, rationale, start, compensating controls). We redacted internal employee identifiers per your request and preserved owner role/title.

Attachments (zipped for convenience; small stubs included inline):
- redwood-scan-rhythm-summary-2028Q3.csv (scan timestamps & tools)
- remediation-evidence-template.xlsx (filled for three CVEs)
- exception-log-redacted.csv
- cve-2028-998-fix-manifest.pdf

If you need Tenable raw JSON exports we can provide them over a secure SFTP; ETA for that is 2028-11-12 due to size and redaction work.

Please confirm receipt and let me know if the SIG reviewer needs any additional linkage (Jira issues or build artifact checksums). Ben will follow up on contractual language if Acme requires a formal SLA annex.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
